script:
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$NOPE/runtime" --expect 404 --check detail eq 'Not Found' --save F12.runtime-errors/unknown
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$NOPE/runtime/reprovision" --expect 404 --check detail eq 'Not Found' --save F12.runtime-errors/unknown-reprovision
control-agent-server api GET <redacted:session-cookie>/not-a-uuid/runtime --expect 422 --check detail.0.type eq uuid_parsing
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie>/not-a-uuid/runtime/reprovision --expect 422 --check detail.0.type eq uuid_parsing
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$N/runtime" --auth none --expect 401 --check detail eq Unauthorized
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$N/runtime/reprovision" --auth none --expect 401 --check detail eq Unauthorized
